newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end down as Hub Power falls.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end down as Hub Power falls.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended slightly down on Friday as sentiment weakend on reports that state power utility WAPDA had threatened Hub Power to terminate its power purchase agreement with the company, dealers said.

"The WAPDA has accused Hub Power of tampering with meters that records company's power supply to WAPDA," a dealer said. "The news is bad and index could take a dip if Hub Power fails to make settlement with the government at the earliest." The Hub Power denied the charge.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) index fell 3.81 points, or 0.25 percent, to end at 1,543.46. Losers led gainers 147 to 81.
Turnover fell to 48.87 million shares from 56.80 on Thursday.
Hub Power fell 0.55 to 37.35 rupees and ICI Pakistan 0.40 to 24.45. PTCL rose 0.50 to 25.70.
